_: Every host that points at a Cloudflare Pages project, and the ONE place that maps an address to an app. Add a line here, push to main, and .github/workflows/domains.yml attaches the host to the project and creates its DNS record. Nothing here is ever deleted by the script: removing a line does NOT remove the host. `enabled: false` is written down but not applied yet. `folder` is where the app's files live in the site (the sub-domain's root shows it, functions/_middleware.js reads this file). `clean: true` also takes the folder out of any address that carries it. `old` lists extra old addresses of the same app. `redirectOld` (top level) sends every old floa.co.il address to its sub-domain: keep it false until the Worker has been deployed with the new origins.

hosts.note: the real site; swapped with a safety net: the old records come back by themselves if Pages does not activate the host in 4 minutes
